shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc "git status -sb; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; cat src/orchestration/usageTotals.test.ts; cat src/orchestration/usageTotals.ts; cat src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts; rg -n 'usage|validated by|Status' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts; cat package.json"
/bin/zsh -lc "cat src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts; cat scripts/check-spec-links.mjs | head -100; ls scripts/spec-links; rg -n 'stopReason|toolCalls' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc "git log -5 --oneline; cat AGENTS.md; rg -n 'while \\(|for \\(;;|starting round|jest.setTimeout' src/orchestration/*.test.ts; sed -n '24,34p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; git show 78837c9:src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts | rg -n 'for \\(|budgetSpent|normalizeToolRounds'"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md')
s=p.read_text().replace(')). A turn with no reported usage leaves the total undefined', ')).\\n- A turn with no reported usage leaves the total undefined')
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('.lore/dod.md')
s=p.read_text().replace('## Out of scope', '- [ ] Investigate the CI test-suite timeout if it recurs; the reported log does not identify a failing test.\\n\\n## Out of scope')
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('.lore/dod.md')
s=p.read_text().replace('## Facets\\n', '## Facets\\n\\n- [x] Place each usage test citation at the end of its own spec statement.\\n')
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md
git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
git commit -m 'fix(spec): place usage citations at statement ends'
git push origin HEAD
git fetch origin main
git merge origin/main --no-edit
git push origin HEAD
git status -sb"
